App details

Fraction Calculator

Calculate with fractions, mixed numbers and decimals, see the steps and recall past calculations.

Coming soonIn developmentAndroid

What it’s for

Add, subtract, multiply, divide and simplify fractions and mixed numbers, with step-by-step working and fraction–decimal conversion.

Main features

  • Add, subtract, multiply, divide and simplify.
  • Convert between fractions and decimals.
  • Local history of up to 100 calculations and persistent memory.
  • Fractional-inch helper for practical measurements.

The app is being tested. See Availability below for its current download status.

Features in detail

Fractions, explanations and workshop notation

Four operations and simplification

Enter integers, fractions, mixed numbers or finite decimals. Add, subtract, multiply or divide, using parentheses and integer powers as needed. Exact results are reduced to simplest form. Zero denominators and division by zero are rejected.

Mixed numbers and improper fractions

Convert between mixed and improper forms: 2 1/3 = 7/3. A negative sign applies to the whole mixed number, so −2 1/3 = −7/3. Both result forms represent the same exact value.

Decimals, percentages and repeating digits

Convert a finite decimal to a fraction, such as 0.125 = 1/8, or view a fraction as decimal and percentage: 3/4 = 0.75 = 75%. Repeating digits are marked with local mathematical notation; a shortened rounded value is clearly labelled approximate.

Steps, common denominators and reduction

Inspect the arithmetic explanation to see common denominators, adjusted numerators and simplification. The least common multiple helps find a denominator; the greatest common divisor explains reduction. Multiplication and division show the fraction operation and its simplified result.

Reciprocal, comparison and copying

Swap numerator and denominator to find the reciprocal of a nonzero fraction. Compare two values exactly, even when they look identical after rounding. Copy the comparison or the displayed result for use elsewhere.

Fractional inches

Enter a value in inches and choose a fractional resolution up to 1/64. Round to the nearest fraction, down or up. See the exact input, the rounded value and their difference. This tool uses fractional inches.

Local history and memory

The test version stores up to 100 completed calculations on the device. Recall an entry to reuse its inputs, delete an entry or clear the list. Use the separate calculator memory to add, subtract, recall or clear a value. The stored memory remains between sessions.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

The test version’s calculations are free. An optional one-time purchase removes banner ads when Google Play offers it. Play verifies and restores the purchase separately from your calculation data. There is no subscription.

Availability

Coming soon. The app is in closed testing and is not yet publicly available to download.
